mcp_tools.name: prediction_model_leakage_calibration_audit
mcp_tools.title: Prediction model leakage calibration audit
mcp_tools.description: Submit a prediction-model evidence manifest (target and decision, baseline and holdout, split/feature declarations with availability times, calibration observations, drift and deployment posture); get a deterministic PREDICTION_AUDIT_SOUND / PREDICTION_AUDIT_UNSOUND / INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE verdict across six sections, including computed feature-availability leakage, temporal-split, holdout-beats-baseline and calibration-error checks, with per-check evidence.

inputSchema.description: The prediction-model evidence manifest (see the atom's SERVICE.md for the field table and features[]/calibration schemas).

prediction_time.description: Prediction time features must be available by.

holdout.description: Holdout evidence (untouched, model vs baseline scores).

validation.description: Validation evidence (split documented, no peeking, no random split for temporal data).

approach.description: Model-ladder and threshold evidence (simple first, thresholds from decision costs).

calibration.description: Calibration evidence: observations (predicted vs observed) and declared max tolerated error.

evaluation.description: Evaluation evidence (calibration and segment errors reported).

deployment.description: Deployment evidence (versioned model and card, rollback path, no silent updates).

quality gate: monitor input drift and live performance
feedback loops identified — predictions change behavior change data
quality gate: retrain policy in place before relying on the model
deploy carefully: versioned model + card
rollout with monitoring and a rollback path
skill red line: no silent model updates in production
